meta.name: infographic-syntax-creator
meta.description: Generate AntV Infographic syntax outputs. Use when asked to turn user content into the Infographic DSL (template selection, data structuring, theme), or to output `infographic <template>` plain syntax.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将用户内容转为 AntV 信息图语法
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用 AntV 语法快速生成信息图
copy.tagline_en: Turn user content into AntV infographic syntax
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly generate infographics using AntV syntax

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会根据你的内容生成 AntV Infographic 语法代码。它会提取标题、描述、项目、层级、指标等结构，选择合适的模板，并输出纯代码块。
howto.when: 当你要求将内容转为信息图 DSL（模板选择、数据组织、主题），或要求输出 `infographic <template>` 纯语法时触发。

say.text: 用对比模板生成信息图

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude generates AntV Infographic syntax from your content. It extracts title, description, items, hierarchy, metrics, selects a matching template, and outputs a plain code block.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to convert content into Infographic DSL (template selection, data structuring, theme) or to output `infographic <template>` plain syntax.

say_en.text: Turn this text into infographic syntax
say_en.note: Claude extracts structure and outputs code

say_en.text: Generate an infographic using compare template
say_en.note: Claude uses compare-* template with two root nodes
